sectorReasoning.reason: Discusses how transaction assets/liabilities/capital structure affect construction-investor risk without inventing synergies.

counterevidence.reason: Approved resolutions and defined ratio are balanced against outstanding approvals and extended deadline.

numericalInterpretation.reason: Correct exchange ratio and hypothetical shares; no fabricated fractional settlement.

decisionUsefulness.reason: Requests current completion, capitalization and pro-forma economics before action.

uncertainty.reason: Explicitly preserves contingent status and distinguishes dilution arithmetic from economic loss.

missingEvidence: No current investment/market validation inferred; source inspection covers relevant selected pages rather than full issuer due diligence.
